verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The durable ingress, per-endpoint fan-out, signed/idempotent delivery, DLQ record preservation, operator replay with unchanged identity, and pause/resume retention requirements are represented clearly and consistently.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The retry-policy contract is incomplete: timeout and network-failure triggers, exponential backoff, jitter, maximum attempts, and the exhausted-retries-to-DLQ path are absent.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board strongly covers the primary ingress-to-delivery architecture and much of the recovery and tenant-control contract. Weighted coverage is 41/54 = 0.7593. However, six system-defining retry and failure-semantics requirements are absent, and observability only shows successful completions rather than all attempts and outcomes. The absent system-defining requirements impose the RC cap of 6.
